Subject: Board packet prep: Q2 ARR/bookings + pipeline commits

Team —

We're on a tight cadence to finalize the Q2 board packet. Key asks before EOD Friday:

- Sales: update SFDC stages on any deals you expect to count in Q2 bookings or materially shift the commit (Aditya + Rachel). I will run a commit review on Monday but want clean data now. Please set "Commit Status" and attach the latest SOW/PO where available.
- Finance: Evelyn, please reconcile the ARR roll-forward in the draft spreadsheet (attached) vs. GL-backed bookings and note any one-offs.
- Finance/CFO: Markus, if there are any revenue timing items we should call out in the narrative (billing cadence, delayed starts), flag them here.

Attached: Q2_Board_Metrics_Draft.xlsx (metrics tab + notes), Pipeline_Commit_List.csv (raw export). I also dropped a working slides deck for the investor-facing narrative we can prune: Investor_Prep_Slides.pdf.

Timing: I’ll consolidate a final pack on Friday evening and circulate to the board admin for Monday distribution. If you’re not able to meet the EOD Friday window, tell me now and include expected completion timestamp.

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: Q2_Board_Metrics_Draft.xlsx (xlsx), Pipeline_Commit_List.csv (csv), Investor_Prep_Slides.pdf (pdf)

Laura —

On it. Quick status:
- HD-4821 (Enterprise SI) — legal final, PO expected 6/25; sales stage still Contracting. I will move to Commit:Commit-Soft with note "PO incoming 6/25".
- RL-330 (Mid-market) — verbal ok, but finance needs signed SOW. I set stage to Commit:Pending-Docs.
- OL-109 (Strategic partner deal) — pricing conversation today; unlikely to close in Q2.

I'll update SFDC now and upload the SOWs to the deal records. Also added expected ARR contribution and start date in the Pipeline_Commit_List.csv.

Quick question for Evelyn: for bookings recognition — do we include preludes of implementation fees that are invoiced upfront as ARR in the board pack, or list as one-time booking? We can mark them in the notes but want consistent treatment across deals.

— Aditya
Sales Director

Thanks Laura / Aditya —

Short answers:
- Implementation fees: treat as one-time booking unless the contract explicitly spreads them over the subscription term for GAAP purposes. For the board pack we can show a small contribution to bookings and a footnote for recognition. I updated the "Revenue Treatment" column on the metrics draft.
- I reconciled ARR + bookings in the spreadsheet; see tab "ARR_rollforward_v2". There is a $120k difference driven by timing on one renewals batch (renewal receipts posted 6/30 in AR system). I added a comment in the cell and flagged as "timing" — we should disclose this in the narrative.

Aditya — thanks for updating the commit statuses. Please make sure each committed deal has an attached SOW or legal confirmation in SFDC; I pulled two with missing docs (HD-4821 and RL-330).

Markus — open item for you: are we comfortable leaving the deferred revenue estimate as-is or should we run a small sensitivity table for the board? I can add a one-slide sensitivity if you think it's material.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference

Folks —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. I reviewed the updated draft and have three suggested edits for the investor narrative before we lock:

1) ARR: use constant-currency ARR in the headline table and add a second column for actuals in reported FX. That will avoid a surprise for international investors.
2) Bookings: create a small subsection for one-offs (professional services prepayments, partner credits) and net them out in the "recurring vs one-time" waterfall. Evelyn — can you surface the PS prepayments by deal id?
3) Forecast narrative: be explicit about the gating risks for the commit list (legal signoffs, PO timing, EMEA data residency for two prospects). For the board deck, I propose a 1-paragraph "confidence level" per committed deal (High/Medium/Low) with a 1-line rationale. Sales: add the confidence rating to the Pipeline_Commit_List.csv.

I'll take the slides and incorporate the currency footnote + sensitivity table this afternoon, then circulate a locked PDF to Board Admin (cc'ed external). Laura — once you give me sign-off, I'll send the board pack to Board Admin for Monday distribution.

Markus Klein
CFO | Redwood Inference
